title: Israel's Arab-led parties in spotlight after inconclusive election
content: Israel's center-right opposition has a chance to unseat Netanyahu — but backing of Arab-led parties will be key.

title: The incoming class of U.S. senators is full of historic firsts
content: From the first Native American woman elected to the U.S. Senate and the first Muslim who will join the upper chamber to the Senate's first Paralympian, voters elected historic candidates on Tuesday.

title: Trump's global health strategy is emerging. What will the Democratic Congress say?
content: The Trump Administration has ushered in a fundamental shift in the U.S. approach to global health aid. How will the newly elected Democratic Congress weigh in?

title: No one knows how many ballots are outstanding in Mississippi's Senate race
content: The razor-thin margin between GOP Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith and Democrat Scott Colom is shining a light on an election process in Mississippi that is among the slowest and most decentralized in the U.S.

title: Stephen Miller will replace Susie Wiles as Trump's chief of staff
content: The change comes after sweeping Republican losses in the midterm elections.

title: Pope Leo begins a 12-day, 3-country South America tour after his cancer surgery
content: Pope Leo begins his first South American tour since lung cancer surgery. The 12-day journey takes him to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, where he spent two decades.

title: Health intel-sharing group warns industry in wake of cyberattack on French blood bank
content: A healthcare intelligence-sharing organization is warning its members to lock down systems following cyberattacks on cold storage systems, including a French blood bank.

title: Remembering 'Star Trek' actor Patrick Stewart
content: Stewart, who died Oct. 28, performed with the Royal Shakespeare Company before becoming famous as Star Trek's Picard. Critic David Bianculli has a tribute, and we listen back to a 2020 interview.

title: European flights and broadcasters are targeted with another wave of bomb threats
content: Officials across Europe reported a slew of bomb threats against multiple flights, following a string of hoaxes that caused flight diversions this week. Three broadcasters also received threats.

title: The leader of a Kenyan doomsday cult is sentenced to 200 years in prison
content: Cult leader Paul Mackenzie was convicted of murdering 190 children and one adult after he ordered his followers to starve themselves to death in order to meet Jesus.
